unit.why: A single narrative, quoted from Zohar Hai, about R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov's six-hour Shavuot prayer and his perceiving at a distance that a hasid's children were ill.

stories.start_quote: פ״א בשנת תקע״א לפרט בחג שבועות
stories.summary_en: On Shavuot 1811 R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov prayed the silent Amidah for six hours; when a householder named Yosef complained that he was being made to suffer, the rebbe gave him wine and revealed that both his children at home had fallen ill, that his prayer had saved one, and that the other was in danger, which the man found to be exactly true when he rode home.

quotes: ועמד ששה שעות רצופים תפלת לחש של שחרית
tags.why: Six-hour Amidah; the rebbe's prayer saves the child

quotes: ואמר תהלים עד שסיים כל תהלים
tags.why: The householder recites the whole book of Psalms

quotes: האמת שהנחת בביתך שני ילדים בריאים והיום נחלו שניהם
tags.why: The rebbe knows of the illness at a distance

quotes: שהמשכתי לו חיים ות"ל חזר לאיתנו
tags.why: His prayer saved a child near death
The rebbe states he must perform a soul-repair for each person
